items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Buster Smith took Stovall's place... You would have had these changes when Buster Smith came in the band.

ctx.x: (Side A of Tape 4 begins at this point.)

Buster Smith, we've got to figure out where--you would have gotten Buster--Buster was playing with Eddie Durham, when Eddie Durham had that big band up in Bridgeport in 1940, Buster was in his band and Buster and Eddie were doing that job that summer. You must have gotten Buster not long after that.
Where did Willard Brown go, to New York?
